attributes.title: RSNA 2026
attributes.summary:
RSNA 2026, the Radiological Society of North America's annual meeting, runs November 29 to December 3, 2026, in Chicago, with technical exhibits open November 29 to December 2. The theme is "At the Center of Care".

The meeting is held at McCormick Place. Registration is open: Full Access members attend at no extra charge, Standard members pay $600 and members-in-training $200, while non-member physicians, physicists and scientists pay $2,525 for in-person plus virtual access, $1,505 in person only or $1,120 virtual only. Recordings stay available until February 26, 2027. RSNA offers discounted rates at partner hotels; the CME credit total is not stated on the pages we checked. RSNA has also announced that its 2027 meeting moves two weeks earlier, to November 14 to 18, 2027.
